_comment: VergoAI pre-control profile for BlueStacks 5 + Brawl Stars. BlueStacks 5 already ships default controls for Space (attack), Shift (super), F (gadget), Q (play), WASD (move). This profile only documents what VergoAI uses -- you may need to add the four missing keys (H, Y, T, U) in BlueStacks Controls Editor.

must_add_in_controls_editor.label: Hypercharge
must_add_in_controls_editor.notes: Tap the hypercharge button. BlueStacks default doesn't include it.

must_add_in_controls_editor.label: Reconnect (connection error)
must_add_in_controls_editor.notes: Centre of the 'Connection error' popup. Use BlueStacks Flight Mode to make the popup appear so you can see the exact button position before mapping.

must_add_in_controls_editor.label: Chaos Drop
must_add_in_controls_editor.notes: Centre-screen tap to claim a Chaos drop variant.

must_add_in_controls_editor.label: Nova Drop
must_add_in_controls_editor.notes: Centre-screen tap to claim a Nova drop variant.
